icons.name: icon
icons.note: WAIVED — Outer 'icon' frame (36×36 round tinted bg) wraps each result-dialog tone icon. Impl renders the bg via View styles + a Feather glyph child — no <svg> on the bg frame itself. The named child icon (icon-check / Danger Triangle / Close Circle / Letter / Clock Circle) is separately waived; the bg frame's box/color is still validated by token diff. (was: Figma icon has 1 vector path(s) but impl renders no <svg> here — likely a font-glyph/raster icon. Replace with a Figma SVG mark.)
